title: Helicopter with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- main body -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="58" rx="26" ry="18" fill="#ff6b35"/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="53" rx="22" ry="12" fill="#ff9a5c"/>
  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="55" rx="10" ry="9" fill="#7fd4ff"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="53" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#b3e8ff"/>
  <!-- tail boom -->
  <rect x="14" y="54" width="16" height="8" rx="3" fill="#e05520"/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d="M10 50 L18 54 L18 62 L10 66 Z" fill="#ff6b35"/>
  <!-- tail rotor -->
  <circle cx="11" cy="50" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#c0e8ff" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- main rotor mast -->
  <rect x="46" y="32" width="4" height="10" fill="#e05520"/>
  <!-- main rotor blades -->
  <rect x="20" y="29" width="56" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#c0e8ff"/>
  <rect x="23" y="26" width="50" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#e8f6ff"/>
  <!-- skids -->
  <rect x="30" y="78" width="36" height="4" rx="2" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <rect x="34" y="74" width="4" height="6" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <rect x="58" y="74" width="4" height="6" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <!-- smiley face on body -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="53" r="3" fill="#2b1a5e"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="53" r="3" fill="#2b1a5e"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="52" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="52" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M37 60 Q46 68 55 60" fill="none" stroke="#2b1a5e" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="59" r="3" fill="#ff9ec4" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="59" r="3" fill="#ff9ec4" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
